title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the 2011 Work Priorities of the People's Courts
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Work Priorities for People's Courts in 2011

Fa Fa [2011] No. 1

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Work Priorities for People's Courts in 2011 are hereby issued to you for your earnest implementation.

January 14, 2011

Work Priorities for People's Courts in 2011

2011 is the first year of implementing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan. People's courts bear a significant responsibility and arduous task in providing judicial guarantees for economic and social development. The overall requirements for the work of people's courts this year are as follows: fully implement the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third, Fourth, and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the Seventeenth Central Committee; take Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of the Three Represents as guidance; deeply implement the Scientific Outlook on Development; accurately grasp the new changes and new features of the domestic and international situation; firmly grasp the theme of scientific development; closely focus on the main line of accelerating the transformation of the economic development model; deeply advance the three key tasks; comprehensively strengthen trial enforcement work and self-construction; and provide stronger judicial guarantees for promoting sound and rapid economic and social development during the Twelfth Five-Year Plan period. Following discussion by the Party Group of the Supreme People's Court, the work priorities for people's courts in 2011 are determined as follows:

I. Adhere to Active Justice, Provide Stronger Judicial Guarantees for Long-term Stable and Rapid Economic Development During the Twelfth Five-Year Plan Period

1. Earnestly implement the spirit of the National Political and Legal Work Conference and the Conference of Presidents of High People's Courts. Thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the National Political and Legal Work Conference and the Conference of Presidents of High People's Courts. Deeply understand the situation and tasks facing people's courts. Accurately grasp the opportunities and challenges facing people's court work under the new circumstances. Adhere to active justice. Focus on deepening the three key tasks. Take deepening judicial system and work mechanism reforms as the driving force. Take strengthening the party building and team building of people's courts as the guarantee. Comprehensively carry out all trial and enforcement work to provide strong judicial guarantees for economic and social development during the Twelfth Five-Year Plan period.

2. Provide high-quality judicial services for maintaining national security and social stability. Punish according to law all types of crimes endangering national security, crimes seriously affecting the public's sense of security, corruption crimes, and crimes of dereliction of duty and infringement of rights, to maintain national security and social stability. Earnestly implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. Solidly advance the standardization of sentencing. Strictly enforce criminal evidence rules. Earnestly implement the Criminal Law Amendment (VIII) of the People's Republic of China, which has been deliberated and adopted, to improve the quality of criminal trials. Vigorously promote social management innovation. Actively participate in the management, education, and assistance of special groups, comprehensive management of public security, and management of the virtual society on the internet. Properly handle various types of mass incidents and individual extreme incidents. Establish a social stability risk assessment mechanism to prevent and reduce conflicts at the source and promote social harmony.

3. Provide high-quality judicial services for accelerating the transformation of the economic development model. Adjudicate according to law disputes in finance, commerce, logistics, and other fields. Prudently handle enterprise bankruptcy and company liquidation cases to promote the development and improvement of the modern industrial system. Adjudicate according to law disputes in consumption, investment, foreign trade, maritime, and other areas to promote a new situation where consumption, investment, and exports coordinately drive economic growth. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights. Actively participate in special campaigns against intellectual property infringement and the production and sale of counterfeit and shoddy goods to enhance independent innovation capabilities and the country's core competitiveness. Adjudicate according to law various types of public nuisance pollution compensation cases. Combat crimes destroying the ecological environment. Promote energy conservation and emission reduction. Enhance the level of ecological civilization.

4. Provide high-quality judicial services for ensuring and improving people's livelihoods. Combat according to law criminal activities such as telecom network fraud, fundraising fraud, production and sale of toxic and harmful food, production and sale of counterfeit and substandard medicines, and major liability accidents, to protect the lives, health, and property safety of the people. Properly adjudicate according to law disputes in labor employment, social security, education, medical care, housing, consumption, and other fields to earnestly safeguard the vital interests of the people. Carefully study legal issues arising in the work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. Properly resolve disputes such as agricultural product transactions, claims for labor remuneration by migrant workers, and rural land contracts to protect farmers' rights, promote agricultural development, and maintain rural stability. Prudently handle administrative disputes such as land acquisition and house demolition, balancing support for local development with protecting the legitimate rights and interests of administrative counterparts. Earnestly study and implement the revised State Compensation Law to effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of compensation claimants.

II. Adhere to the Principle of "Mediation First, Combination of Mediation and Adjudication," Actively Promote the Resolution of Social Conflicts

5. Accurately understand the basic spirit of the principle of "Mediation First, Combination of Mediation and Adjudication." Correctly handle the relationship between mediation and adjudication. Adhere to the standards of being conducive to resolving disputes, defusing conflicts, and achieving case closure and matter resolution. Reasonably choose the method of handling cases based on the specific circumstances of each case, effectively resolving social conflicts. Conduct mediation based on the principle of legality and voluntariness. Resolutely avoid practices such as setting mediation rate targets divorced from reality or forcing mediation against the parties' will. If mediation is not possible or unsuccessful, promptly render a judgment.

6. Innovate and improve the working mechanism for litigation mediation. Strengthen the concept of "Mediation First." Integrate mediation into all stages of case filing, trial, and enforcement, and throughout the entire process of first instance, second instance, retrial, appeals, and petitions. Establish a full-process mediation mechanism covering criminal, civil, administrative, enforcement, and other fields. Use the rate of automatic performance of mediated cases to test the effectiveness of mediation. Further improve the evaluation mechanism that can truly reflect the quality of mediation work, so that mediation truly plays its due role.

7. Innovate and improve the mechanism for resolving disputes through the connection between litigation and non-litigation methods. Further strengthen the work of connecting litigation and mediation. Summarize and promote the experience and practices of setting up litigation-mediation connection centers and establishing people's mediation studios in case filing halls. Actively guide parties to choose people's mediation, administrative mediation, industry mediation, and other methods to resolve disputes nearby and on the spot, striving to resolve conflicts before litigation.

8. Innovate and improve the working mechanism for the "Grand Mediation" system. Mobilize social forces to resolve conflicts and disputes. Actively promote the establishment of a "Grand Mediation" work pattern with leadership by party committees, guidance by the government, participation by all parties, and with people's mediation, administrative mediation, and judicial mediation each performing their respective functions and coordinating with each other. Earnestly study and implement the People's Mediation Law. Improve the mechanism for judicial confirmation of people's mediation agreements. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with people's mediation organizations to enable them to play a better role. Strengthen connections with relevant administrative organs and industry organizations, providing them with legal services for mediating related cases. Standardize the standards for judicial review of arbitration awards. Support arbitration institutions in their work, enabling them to play an important role in dispute resolution.

III. Adhere to Justice for the People, Focus on Solving the Problems of Difficulty in Litigation and Enforcement

9. Further strengthen judicial convenience work. Strengthen the construction of case filing and petition windows. Improve functional settings and standardize work systems. Strive to build case filing and petition windows into "windows for the people, windows of civilization, windows of harmony, and windows of credibility." Promote the spirit of the Ma Xiwu trial method. Improve circuit trials. Set up specialized tribunals or collegiate panels in places where related cases are concentrated. Actively explore practices such as online case filing, service, trial, and evaluation. Properly carry out pilot work on the expedited adjudication mechanism for small-amount cases. Increase judicial assistance efforts so that the people can personally feel the convenience and efficiency of justice.

10. Further improve the work on litigation-related petitions. Earnestly carry out the work of clearing up backlogged litigation-related petition cases. While ensuring quality, accelerate the work progress and ensure case closure and acceptance. Adhere to practices such as leaders personally receiving petitioners, judges taking cases to visit grassroots areas, and circuit petition reception, to effectively solve problems reflected in people's petitions. Do a good job in resolving petition cases. Implement the Measures for the Conclusion of Litigation-Related Petitions in People's Courts, ensuring that on the premise of clear basic facts, correct application of law, and fair substantive handling, the parties are induced to cease petitions. Strengthen the responsibilities of first and second instances. Do a good job in handling first-time letters and visits, preventing and reducing petition cases at the source.

11. Further solve the problem of difficulty in enforcement. Solidly carry out the activity of creating "Advanced Courts with No Backlogged Enforcement Cases" and the special campaign to clear up entrusted enforcement cases, achieving the healthy development of enforcement work. Strengthen the separation and balance of powers. Refine the enforcement coordination and deterrence mechanism. Continuously improve the long-term mechanism conducive to the smooth progress of enforcement work. Actively promote the enactment of compulsory enforcement legislation to provide strong institutional guarantees for solving enforcement difficulties. Solidly advance the informatization of enforcement work. Improve the enforcement case information management system to create conditions for improving enforcement levels. Focus on solving the problem of evading enforcement by judgment debtors. Timely carry out special campaigns against evasion of enforcement, effectively safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of creditors.

IV. Adhere to Reform and Innovation, Promote the Establishment of a Scientific Judicial System and Working Mechanism

12. Deeply advance the judicial reform tasks determined by the Central Committee and the Supreme People's Court. Adhere to the principle of "grasping the direction, basing on national conditions, advancing according to law, and ensuring fairness." Accelerate the advancement of two reform tasks determined by the Central Committee: the death penalty review procedure and the judicial guarantee system. Actively promote the advancement of tasks determined by the Third Five-Year Reform Outline, such as the establishment of a judicial affairs supervision system, a system separating petitions from litigation, and a judge integrity archive system. And firmly implement various reform achievements.

13. Deeply advance judicial openness, judicial democracy, and supervision and restriction. Actively promote the online publication of judgments, access to litigation files, and other tasks. Vigorously carry out activities to learn from "Demonstration Courts of Judicial Openness." Further improve the people's assessor system. Appropriately increase the number of people's assessors. Expand the scope of selection of assessors. Increase the proportion of ordinary people among assessors. Strengthen the management and training of assessors. Expand the scope of cases with assessor participation. Better leverage the role of people's assessors. Strengthen internal supervision by people's courts, such as trial supervision. At the same time, consciously accept supervision by the People's Congress, democratic supervision by the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, legal supervision by the procuratorial organs, and supervision by all sectors of society, ensuring that people's courts perform their duties according to law and adjudicate impartially.

14. Deeply advance innovation in trial management. Establish and improve trial management systems such as quality assessment, case evaluation, process management, assessment and rewards and punishments, and supervision and guidance, to achieve standardization of trial management. Explore and establish a reasonable indicator assessment system to achieve scientific trial management. Vigorously promote the "Balance Project." Accelerate the construction of a trial management network covering courts at all four levels nationwide. Build a national court case information database. Promote the extensive application of information technology in trial enforcement work, achieving informatization of trial management.

V. Adhere to the Principle of Party Building Leading Team Building to Promote Trials, Comprehensively Improve the Overall Quality of the Court Team

15. Vigorously strengthen the party building of people's courts. Strengthen the self-construction of party groups at all levels of courts and the construction of court party committees, party branches, and party groups. Adhere to the principle of establishing party branches in tribunals. Improve the organizational life system. Strengthen the assessment of party members' party spirit, party discipline, and work. Solidly carry out activities to strive for excellence, ensuring that party branches play a role as battle fortresses and party members play a vanguard and exemplary role. Establish a party building guidance mechanism. Strengthen guidance on party building in lower-level courts, forming a party building work pattern of combining sectoral and territorial aspects, linking upper and lower levels, and promoting overall progress. In accordance with the Central Committee's deployment, organize and carry out propaganda, education, and commemorative activities for the 90th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, pushing court party building work to a new level.

16. Deeply carry out two thematic practice activities. Incorporate the "People's Judge for the People" thematic practice activity into the "Carry Forward Traditions, Strengthen Beliefs, Uphold the Law for the People" thematic education and practice activity organized by the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. In accordance with the unified requirements of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission and the deployment of the Supreme People's Court, highlight the two key points of strengthening party building and judicial work style. Combine with the actual conditions of courts in various regions. Strengthen organizational leadership. Ensure work implementation. Ensure that both activities achieve practical results.

17. Solidly advance court training work. Earnestly implement the education and training work policy of "one goal, two transformations, three advocacies." Strictly implement the 2011-2015 National Court Education and Training Plan. Optimize training content. Innovate training methods. Improve training quality. Actively promote full-staff training, thematic training, preparatory judge training, specialized training, on-the-job training, training of bilingual judges for ethnic minorities, and professional skills training for judicial police, comprehensively enhancing the judicial capability of the court team.

18. Effectively improve judicial work style. Adhere to the party's mass line. Firmly establish mass viewpoints. Deeply carry out discussions on mass viewpoints. In connection with the actual thinking of court work and judicial personnel, conduct targeted self-examination and self-correction to ensure that mass viewpoints are deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. Closely connect with the masses. Actively carry out activities to visit grassroots areas, promptly listening to opinions and suggestions from the masses on court work. Use public opinion surveys and other methods to understand society's evaluation of court work. Actively carry out activities to create courts and judges that satisfy the people. Adhere to the style of seeking truth and being pragmatic. Focus on solving practical problems. Resolutely overcome formalism. Resolutely rectify the mountains of documents and seas of meetings.

19. Focus on strengthening court culture construction. Actively carry out research, education, and practice on core judicial values. Earnestly implement the newly revised Basic Standards for Judges' Professional Ethics and Code of Conduct for Judges, and the newly formulated Basic Standards for Civilized Language in People's Courts. Continue to strengthen model court culture construction. Launch cultural construction projects with the characteristics of courts in various regions. Expand the participation and influence of court culture construction. Improve and perfect the leadership organization and working institutions for court culture construction. Implement the court culture construction plan. Strengthen the construction of cultural infrastructure.

20. Strive to promote judicial integrity. Deeply implement the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. Further implement the concepts of putting people first and governing for the people. Solidly carry out the construction of party conduct and clean government. Explore new ways of anti-corruption work. Strengthen judicial integrity education. Continue to carry out positive model demonstration education and negative model warning education. Urge the vast number of judicial personnel to be self-disciplined and steadfastly hold the line. Strengthen the construction of systems with greater supervisory and restrictive power. Earnestly implement the "Four Absolutes" proposed by the National Political and Legal Work Conference and the "Five Prohibitions" of the Supreme People's Court. Step up efforts to investigate and punish violations of discipline and law. Improve the working mechanisms for accepting online tip-offs, verifying clues of disciplinary violations, and supervising major cases. Improve the evaluation system and accountability system for handling cases. Always maintain a high-pressure stance against corruption. Advance the construction of a punishment and prevention corruption system in people's courts, constructing a clean government risk prevention mechanism that conforms to the laws of trial work.

VI. Adhere to Grasping the Foundation at the Grassroots Level, Comprehensively Strengthen Grassroots Work and Construction

21. Effectively strengthen guidance on grassroots work. Intermediate people's courts and above should improve macro-guidance and classified guidance mechanisms. Vigorously enhance their own work level. Strive to master the rules of judicial work. Earnestly conduct research and argumentation. Listen more to opinions from front-line judicial personnel. Enhance the pertinence, effectiveness, and authority of supervision and guidance. Strengthen work inspections to ensure that various supervision and guidance measures are implemented and achieve practical results.

22. Promote the resolution of practical difficulties faced by grassroots courts. Continue to promote the reform of personnel recruitment methods. Broaden the sources and channels for judges. Strengthen supervision over solving the problem of judges' early retirement. Effectively alleviate the situation of more cases and fewer personnel and judge shortages in grassroots courts. Actively promote the reform of the judicial examination. Implement preferential policies to effectively solve the problem of difficulty in recruiting and retaining personnel in courts in remote western regions. Strengthen the construction of front-line security teams. Increase investment in security inspection facilities and police equipment. Apply to increase the establishment of judicial police according to the needs of police work. Coordinate with relevant parties to effectively improve the rank and treatment of judicial police, stabilizing the judicial police team. Strive for the care and support of party committees, people's congresses, and governments at all levels. Continue to advance the reform of the court funding guarantee system. Establish a normal growth mechanism for public funding. Further improve the funding guarantee situation at the grassroots level. Continue to do a good job in restoring or newly building people's tribunals in remote, ethnic regions, and other areas where it is inconvenient for people to litigate. Improve law enforcement conditions to meet the growing judicial needs of the people.

23. Promote the resolution of practical problems in the work and life of grassroots court judicial personnel. Care for judicial personnel politically. Actively strive for the support of party committees, governments, and organization and personnel departments. Implement the rank of judges properly. Timely promote, use, commend, and reward outstanding judicial personnel. Encourage the advanced and promote righteousness. Support judicial personnel in their work. Help them eliminate interference, ensuring fair, efficient, honest, and civilized justice. Create opportunities for judicial personnel to study and train, enabling them to continuously acquire new knowledge and increase new skills. Care for judicial personnel in their lives. Create conditions to implement relevant subsidies. Attempt to establish insurance systems for major injuries and major diseases. Regularly organize physical examinations for judicial personnel. Carry out colorful cultural and sports activities. Continuously improve the living conditions of judicial personnel. Do a good job in the work of retired cadres. Enable the vast number of judicial personnel to truly feel the care and warmth of the organization.

VII. Adhere to Party Leadership, Provide Strong Political Guarantees for Court Work

24. Always adhere to the correct direction of people's court work. Firmly establish political awareness and overall concept. Unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics. Consciously adhere to the party's basic theory, basic line, basic program, and basic experience. Consciously adhere to the "Three Supremes." Closely plan court work around the overall work of the party and the state. Ensure ideological, political, and action alignment with the Central Committee of the Party. Ensure that people's court work always conforms to the overall work deployment of the party and the state. Fully leverage the function of serving economic and social development. Adhere to the system of reporting important work deployments and major reform matters to the party committee. Consciously accept the leadership and supervision of the party, ensuring that all decisions and deployments of the party are implemented without compromise in people's courts.

25. Strengthen ideological work in the judicial field. Adhere to the party's leadership over ideological work. Earnestly implement the spirit of the National Conference of Directors of Propaganda Departments. Intensify judicial propaganda work. Vigorously promote the Sinicization, modernization, and popularization of Marxist legal thought. More effectively strengthen education on the concept of socialist rule of law. Strengthen theoretical research in people's courts. Enable the vast number of judicial personnel to identify with Marxist legal thought theoretically, ideologically, emotionally, and practically, ensuring that the Marxist view of law guides judicial ideology.

26. Further implement the principle of the party managing cadres. Improve and strengthen co-management work. In conjunction with local leadership transitions, responsibly put forward co-management opinions to ensure that the leadership teams of people's courts at all levels are fully staffed and strong. Improve and strengthen the selection and cultivation of cadres. In accordance with the principle of both integrity and ability, with integrity first, and the provisions of the Judges Law, select and promote outstanding cadres with firm political stance, good moral character, familiarity with the law, and solid work style to leadership positions in courts. Improve and strengthen regular assessments of cadres, including leading cadres. Timely identify problems and adopt different methods to properly resolve them. Encourage everyone to focus on their duties, work hard, and better serve the overall situation and administer justice for the people.
